name: Bouncer
summary: Real-time email verification with deliverability status, reason, score and domain/account flags, plus domain catch-all checks and batch result downloads.

api_key.description: A Bouncer API key (Bouncer app > API > Generate API Key). Sent in the x-api-key header.

notes: status is deliverable, risky (accept-all, full mailbox or disposable), undeliverable or unknown; reason narrows it (accepted_email, low_deliverability, low_quality, invalid_email, invalid_domain, rejected_email, dns_error, unavailable_smtp, unsupported, timeout, unknown).
Flag fields (acceptAll, disposable, free, role, disabled, fullMailbox) are the strings 'yes', 'no' or 'unknown', not booleans.
A 402 means the account has run out of credits; a 503 can be retried.
Addresses at sandbox.usebouncer.com (deliverable@, undeliverable@, accept-all@, disposable@, unknown@ ...) are free to verify while testing.
Creating a batch, the synchronous batch queue and toxicity list jobs take a raw JSON array body and are not in this entry; the status and download calls read a batch created elsewhere.

endpoints.name: Verify one email in real time
endpoints.summary: Status, reason, deliverability score, provider, MX record and accept-all, disposable, free, role, disabled and full-mailbox flags for one address.

timeout.description: Seconds to spend on verification, default 10, maximum 30.

notes: Uses one credit. Limited to 1000 requests per minute by default.
Returns more unknown results than the batch API; a greylisted address comes back with a retryAfter field saying when to try again.

endpoints.name: Verify a domain
endpoints.summary: Whether a domain has valid MX records and whether it accepts all addresses (catch-all), with its mail provider.
notes: Uses one credit. Limited to 1000 requests per minute by default.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: The verification credits left on the account.

endpoints.name: Get a batch's status
endpoints.summary: Status, timestamps, quantity, duplicates, processed count and credits used for a verification batch, with per-status counts on request.

batchId.description: The batchId returned when the batch was created.

with_stats.description: Add processing progress and counts per status.

notes: Poll every 10 to 30 seconds until status is 'completed'; credits is filled in only once the batch is complete.

endpoints.name: Download a batch's results
endpoints.summary: The verification records of a completed batch as JSON, optionally only those with one status.

batchId.description: The batchId returned when the batch was created.
